key_insight: METTA combines fine-grained within-episode adaptation with compact cross-episode memory to support efficient meta-RL adaptation to unseen tasks.
engineering_relevance: Its linear-complexity within-episode memory offers a scalable alternative to transformer retrieval over full interaction histories.
method: Use causal neural memory for fine-grained within-episode adaptation.
Retain compact episode summaries for long-range task inference.
Enable test-time training to adapt to held-out tasks and task families.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports over 50% success on held-out Meta-World ML10/45 test environments and better performance than transformer-based baselines on long-context, sparse-reward PointMaze tasks.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify training costs or test-time update overhead, leaving deployment efficiency to be verified.
paper_title: METTA: Memory-Enhanced Test-Time Adaptation for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
